title: Reconstruction of an embedded configuration
statement: Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $\sigma$ embed the indices of $m$ tapes into those of $k$ tapes, and let $c$ and $d$ be configurations on the same input, with $c$ using state set $S$ and $d$ using the same state set and symbol set. Suppose their states and input-head positions agree, and that concatenating a word $p$ with $c$'s output gives $d$'s output. Suppose also that on every selected tape, $c$'s tape contents and head position agree with those of $d$; on every unselected tape, the supplied tape contents and head position agree with those of $d$. Then embedding $c$ using the supplied tapes and head positions and prefixing its output by $p$ yields $d$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
Tape contents and head positions for the $k$ tapes
Selected tapes agree in contents and head positions
Unselected tapes agree with supplied contents and head positions
